items.title: ’Cuse Rallies Past #19 SMU in Fourth
items.summary: Behind a scary good fourth-quarter offense and four sacks on defense, Syracuse football rallied past No. 19 SMU for a 30-27 Halloween win at the JMA Wireless Dome Saturday afternoon.

items.summary: After an overtime win at North Carolina last week, the Orange return home Saturday to host No. 19 SMU. Kickoff is set for noon, and the game will air on ESPN2.

items.title: Calvin Russell III Named ACC Rookie of the Week
items.summary: Syracuse wide receiver Calvin Russell III has been named the ACC Rookie of the Week, the league announced Monday afternoon. The honor follows a career game for the freshman, who posted eight catches for 86 yards and a touchdown in the Orange's overtime win over North Carolina.
